finalOutput:
The Todo app is complete and verified.

**Delivered:** `todo_openrouter-deepseek-deepseek-v4.1-flash_01.html` (11,793 bytes, 498 lines) — a single self-contained file with HTML, CSS, and JS, no external dependencies.

**Requirements coverage:**
- **Add todos** — form with `submit` handler; trims input, rejects empty, clears and refocuses the field after adding.
- **Mark complete (strikethrough)** — checkbox per item toggles `completed`; `.todo-item.completed .todo-text` applies `text-decoration: line-through` plus a muted color. Handled via both `click` and `change` delegation on the list.
- **Delete todos** — per-item `×` button wired through event delegation on `#todo-list`; also a "Clear completed" button that is disabled when nothing is completed.
- **Filter All / Active / Completed** — three filter buttons with `data-filter`; `getVisibleTodos()` selects the visible subset, the active button gets an `.active` class, and the chosen filter is persisted too.
- **Persist to localStorage** — `load()`/`save()` under key `todos-app-v1`, storing `{ todos, filter }`. Load validates and normalizes entries (drops malformed records, regenerates missing ids) and is wrapped in try/catch so a blocked or full storage never breaks the app.

**Extras included:** live "N items left" counter, contextual empty states (no todos / no active / no completed), keyboard-friendly form submission, ARIA labels on the toggle and delete controls, and a responsive layout that collapses gracefully under 480px.
